questiontext.text:
Find all the \(1^{st}\) order partial derivatives of the following function.

\(\displaystyle f(x, z)={@fxy@}\)


\(\displaystyle \frac{\partial f}{\partial x}=\) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]
\(\displaystyle \frac{\partial f}{\partial z}=\) [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Let's find all the \(1^{st}\) order partial derivatives of the following function.

\( f(x, z)={@fxy@} \)

Since the function has two variables \(x\) and \(z\), then it is to find \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\) and \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial f}{\partial z}\).

Let's start with \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\)

\( \displaystyle \begin{align} \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} & = \frac{\partial }{\partial x} \left( {@(%e^(-x))*sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm)-((cc*x+dd*z)/(ee*z+ff*x))@} \right) \\ & = \frac{\partial }{\partial x} \left( {@(%e^(-x))*sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm)@} \right) - \frac{\partial }{\partial x} \left( {@(cc*x+dd*z)/(ee*z+ff*x)@} \right) \\ & = \frac{\partial }{\partial x} \left( {@(%e^(-x))@} \right) \cdot \left( {@sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm)@} \right) + \frac{\partial }{\partial x} \left( {@sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(%e^(-x))@} \right) -\left[ \frac{\frac{\partial }{\partial x} \left( {@(cc*x+dd*z)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(ee*z+ff*x)@} \right) - \frac{\partial }{\partial x} \left( {@(ee*z+ff*x)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(cc*x+dd*z)@} \right)}{\left( {@ee*z+ff*x@} \right)^{2} } \right] \\ \displaystyle & = \left( {@diff(%e^(-x),x)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm)@} \right) + \left( {@diff(sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm),x)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(%e^(-x))@} \right) - \left[ \frac{\left( {@diff(cc*x+dd*z,x)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(ee*z+ff*x)@} \right) - \left( {@diff(ee*z+ff*x,x)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(cc*x+dd*z)@} \right)}{\left( {@ee*z+ff*x@} \right)^{2} } \right] \\ & = {@ta1@} \end{align} \)

Then \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial f}{\partial z}\)

\( \displaystyle \begin{align} \frac{\partial f}{\partial z} & = \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \left( {@fxy@} \right) \\ & = \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \left( {@(%e^(-x))*sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm)@} \right) - \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \left( {@(cc*x+dd*z)/(ee*z+ff*x)@} \right) \\ & = \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \left( {@(%e^(-x))@} \right) \cdot \left( {@sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm)@} \right) + \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \left( {@sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(%e^(-x))@} \right) -\left[ \frac{\frac{\partial}{\partial z} \left( {@(cc*x+dd*z)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(ee*z+ff*x)@} \right) - \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \left( {@(ee*z+ff*x)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(cc*x+dd*z)@} \right)}{\left( {@ee*z+ff*x@} \right)^{2} } \right] \\ & = \left( {@diff(%e^(-x),z)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm)@} \right) + \left( {@diff(sqrt(aa*z^nn+bb*x^mm),z)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(%e^(-x))@} \right) - \left[ \frac{\left( {@diff(cc*x+dd*z,z)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(ee*z+ff*x)@} \right) - \left( {@diff(ee*z+ff*x,z)@} \right) \cdot \left( {@(cc*x+dd*z)@} \right)}{\left( {@ee*z+ff*x@} \right)^{2} } \right] \\ & = {@ta2@} \end{align} \)
